_comment: Registry of platforms the collector can pull restaurant mentions/reviews from. Countries reference these by id in countries.json.

platforms.name: Google Maps
platforms.api_notes: Google Places API (Text/Nearby Search + reviews) — paid per request, $200/mo free credit. Preferred over browser scraping where budget allows.

platforms.name: Tripadvisor
platforms.api_notes: Content API exists but requires approval process — not instant.

platforms.name: Facebook (Page reviews/mentions)
platforms.api_notes: Graph API requires business verification + page admin access; public scraping is against ToS and heavily defended.

platforms.name: Instagram (hashtag/location mentions)
platforms.api_notes: No public hashtag search API without a verified Business account (Graph API). Highest anti-bot risk of all sources.

platforms.name: Yandex Maps
platforms.api_notes: Geosearch API for org search (free up to 500 req/day) but standard license forbids storing raw results long-term — verify terms before caching history.

platforms.name: 2GIS
platforms.api_notes: Catalog API exists (paid, calculator-based pricing) — confirmed coverage in Azerbaijan; Georgia/Armenia coverage unverified.

platforms.name: TheFork (La Fourchette)
platforms.api_notes: No public consumer-facing API found; restaurant partner API exists but requires partnership.

platforms.name: Yelp
platforms.api_notes: Yelp Fusion API available (free tier with rate limits) — check current ToS on review text redistribution.

platforms.name: Yandex Eda (Yandex Food delivery)
platforms.api_notes: Distinct product from Yandex Maps — confirmed active in Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Armenia, Georgia.

platforms.name: Chocofood
platforms.api_notes: Kazakhstan-founded local delivery platform, strong regional presence.

platforms.name: Google News (RSS)
platforms.api_notes: Free RSS feed, no key required.
